title: Design a permission-aware knowledge assistant
description: Connect identity, retrieval, and generation so restricted source data cannot bypass the authorization boundary.
hint: Follow each directed path from entry to sensitive output. A disconnected guard cannot protect a bypass route.
expertReasoning: The API receives trusted identity; authorized retrieval checks document access before supplying passages to the model. Data can reach the index through an optional ingestion queue. Neither a direct source-to-model connection nor a user-to-model shortcut is acceptable. Diagram checks assume components implement their stated responsibility; deployment tests must still verify actual ACL enforcement, deletion propagation, and authorized citations.

catalog.label: User
catalog.responsibility: A support specialist authenticated for a tenant.

catalog.label: Application API
catalog.responsibility: Trusted orchestration; validates session and propagates identity.

catalog.label: Identity provider
catalog.responsibility: Issues validated caller identity to the API.

catalog.label: Source documents
catalog.responsibility: Private source evidence with document access metadata.

catalog.label: Authorized retrieval
catalog.responsibility: Server-side component that enforces caller ACLs before releasing passages.

catalog.label: Model
catalog.responsibility: Generates an answer from the authorized context only.

catalog.label: Ingestion queue
catalog.responsibility: Optional asynchronous ingestion between sources and retrieval.

rules.message: Provide a directed path from identity to api.
Provide a directed path from api to retrieval.
Every user → model path must pass through api, retrieval.
Every data → model path must pass through retrieval.
